 Final Injury Report for 76ers-Cavaliers: Will Jarrett Allen, Peyton Watson Play?
 Originally posted on
 Athlon Sports 
 By Nathaniel Holloway
  | 
 Last updated Nov 6, 2026 3:30 PM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 The Cleveland Cavaliers are at home Friday night as they host the Philadelphia 76ers in an Eastern Conference showdown as part of NBA Cup group play. 
 Cleveland enters Friday’s game with a 4-4 record after losing on the road to the Oklahoma City Thunder Wednesday night. 
 Cleveland Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell (45)David Richard-Imagn Images
 In Wednesday’s loss, Donovan Mitchell led the way for the Cavaliers as he recorded 27 points, three rebounds and six assists while James Harden added 19 points, nine rebounds and six assists of his own. 
 The Cavaliers will try to bounce back Friday as they face off against the 76ers in a tough home matchup.
 Philadelphia enters Friday’s contest with an 8-1 record after defeating the Detroit Pistons on the road Wednesday night. 
 Philadelphia 76ers guard Jaylen Brown (7)Bill Streicher-Imagn Images
 Jaylen Brown led the way for the 76ers in Wednesday’s victory as he ended the game with 30 points and seven rebounds while Joel Embiid recorded 26 points and 15 rebounds. 
 While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Friday night’s matchup, each may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 76ers Injury Report: Will Adem Bona Play? 
 Philadelphia 76ers center Adem Bona (30)Bill Streicher-Imagn Images
 The 76ers have three players listed on their injury report for Friday, including center Adem Bona.
 Philadelphia has listed Bona as doubtful due to a cervical spine sprain and he is expected to miss his first game of the season.
 The Sixers have an injury report for tomorrow’s game @ Cleveland:
Adem Bona – cervical spine sprain – DOUBTFUL
Dominick Barlow – back – OUT
— Adam Aaronson (@SixersAdam) November 5, 2026 
 With Bona likely to be sidelined, Jabari Walker and Dean Wade could both be in line for increased roles. 
 The 76ers have ruled out Dominick Barlow due to a lower-back stress reaction while Ariel Hukporti will miss the remainder of the season with a torn Achilles. 
 Cavaliers Injury Report: Will Jarrett Allen , Peyton Watson Play? 
 Cleveland Cavaliers center Jarrett Allen (31)© Ken Blaze-Imagn Images
 The Cavaliers have five players listed on their injury report, including Jarrett Allen and Peyton Watson . 
 Cleveland has listed Allen as questionable due to a right knee contusion that he suffered in Wednesday’s loss and he is in danger of missing his first game of the season.
 #Cavs list Jarrett Allen (right knee), Tyrese Proctor (left ankle) and Peyton Watson (right hamstring) all as questionable for tomorrow’s game against Philadelphia. 
Jaylon Tyson (right ankle) is out.
— Danny Cunningham (@RealDCunningham) November 5, 2026 
 If Allen is sidelined, Thomas Bryant and Mario Hezonja could both be in line for increased roles. 
 The Cavaliers have also listed Watson as questionable due to right hamstring injury management and he is in danger of missing his third straight game.
 David Richard-Imagn Images
 Tyrese Proctor has also been listed as questionable due to a left ankle sprain while Jaylon Tyson (right ankle sprain) and Nae’Qwan Tomlin (lower-back stress reaction) have both been ruled out. 
 Fans can catch Friday night’s matchup between the 76ers and Cavaliers from Rocket Arena at 7:30 p.m. ET on Amazon Prime Video.
